payload.title: Correct optimization persistence terminology
payload.description:
As an optimization-tool user, I want public guidance to describe the canonical artifact persistence interface, so that I do not depend on a retired storage-specific contract.

Feature: Canonical optimization persistence terminology

Scenario: Public optimization guidance describes persistence
Given the integrated optimization tools and documentation
When a user reads the runtime contract, CLI help, or optimizer guidance
Then persistence is described as artifact persistence
And no public contract promises a storage-specific Report/S3 path

Excludes changes to persistence behavior or storage architecture.
